# The external contracts

**Generated by `rebuild/tools/extract_contracts.py` - do not edit by hand.**

Everything inside the tool can be redesigned. Everything on this page cannot:
it is the edge, and a rebuild that gets one of these subtly wrong fails in
use rather than in a test.

## Programs this tool shells out to

🔴 **None of these are owned by this repo.** Their output format is a
contract nobody signed, and the knowledge ledger records what was learned
about each the hard way.

| program | what it is for | call sites |
|---|---|---|
| `CIM/WMI` | process tree and command lines | _common.ps1 x6, sessions-window.ps1 x4 |
| `Get-Process` | liveness by pid | _common.ps1 x3 |
| `claude --resume` | reopen a conversation | _common.ps1 x1 |
| `claude agents --json` | the agent/session map | _common.ps1 x13, sessions-window.ps1 x9 |
| `claude auth status` | is the login live | _common.ps1 x2 |
| `taskkill` | end a session process | _common.ps1 x1 |
| `wt.exe` | Windows Terminal - open and focus tabs | _common.ps1 x12, sessions-window.ps1 x2 |

## Files and directories

| path | what it is | touched in |
|---|---|---|
| `.state/` | logs, spliced harnesses, scratch | SessionsHost.cs, _common.ps1, restore-sessions.ps1, sessions-window.ps1 |
| `.state/restore.log` | the log to read when it seems dead | SessionsHost.cs, _common.ps1, restore-sessions.ps1, sessions-window.ps1 |
| `lib/fonts/` | Manrope and IBM Plex Mono, shipped | sessions-window.ps1 |
| `lib/window2.xaml` | the UI tree | SessionsHost.cs, _common.ps1, sessions-window.ps1 |
| `session-restore.config.json` | the operator settings | _common.ps1, sessions-window.ps1 |
| `sessions-registry.json` | THE state file - conversations, ticks, projects | SessionsHost.cs, _common.ps1, restore-sessions.ps1 |
| `~/.claude/projects` | transcripts (.jsonl), read only | _common.ps1, sessions-window.ps1 |

🔴 **`sessions-registry.json` and `session-restore.config.json` are LIVE**
operator files. A registry-overwrite bug in this repo's history cost 210
conversations - which is why the write guards are strict, and why a rebuild
must reproduce them before it is allowed to write anything at all.

## Settings (25)

The operator's existing `session-restore.config.json` must keep working, so
every key here is a fixed point - name, default and allowed values.
An unset key is DRAWN at its default and never written.

| key | group | default | allowed | shown as |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `textRendering` | How it looks | `(unset)` | grayscale, cleartype | How text is rasterised |
| `zoom` | How it looks | `(unset)` | 70..200 | Size of everything on the surface, as a percentage |
| `oauthTokenUrl` | Other settings in this file | `(unset)` |  | Sign-in token endpoint |
| `panelScanMaxAgeSeconds` | Other settings in this file | `(unset)` | 0..86400 | Panel scan freshness (no longer read) |
| `lineSpacing` | The reading pane | `normal` | tight, normal, relaxed | How far apart the lines of a reply sit |
| `readingWidth` | The reading pane | `(unset)` | full, measured | How wide a line of text runs |
| `terminalColour` | The reading pane | `on` | on, off | Colour when you watch a session |
| `transcriptTools` | The reading pane | `(unset)` | folded, full, hidden | How much of the machinery the transcript shows |
| `yourGround` | The reading pane | `neutral` | neutral, orange, blue, violet, none | The background behind your own messages |
| `yourInk` | The reading pane | `normal` | normal, orange, blue, violet | The colour of your own messages |
| `autoTickLaneBudgets` | What comes back at your next logon | `(unset)` |  | Per-project auto-tick budgets |
| `autoTickPerDirectory` | What comes back at your next logon | `(unset)` | 1..1000 | Most conversations auto-ticked per project |
| `autoTickPerWorktree` | What comes back at your next logon | `(unset)` | 1..1000 | Most conversations auto-ticked per worktree |
| `includeWorktrees` | What comes back at your next logon | `(unset)` |  | Reopen conversations from git worktrees |
| `launchGapMs` | What comes back at your next logon | `250` | 0..2000 | Pause between opening one tab and the next |
| `maxSessions` | What comes back at your next logon | `(unset)` | 1..1000 | Most conversations to reopen at once |
| `recencyDays` | What comes back at your next logon | `(unset)` | 1..3650 | Days a project counts as recently worked in |
| `sessionWindowDays` | What comes back at your next logon | `(unset)` | 1..3650 | Days a conversation counts as recently active |
| `foldProjects` | What the lists show | `(unset)` |  | Start with the projects column collapsed |
| `foldSessions` | What the lists show | `(unset)` |  | Start with the conversations column collapsed |
| `listDays` | What the lists show | `7` | 1..3650 | Days of conversations in the list |
